change: Preserve existing cast and contact shadows. Multiply both alpha values by smoothstep of maximum lift from zero to three logical pixels. No new mesh, draw call or shadow buffer.
comparison_method: Same process, same real CBZ input, same textures, 96x24 mesh; interleaved legacy-a/fade-a/fade-b/legacy-b/legacy-c/fade-c for single and double page. Each case includes unmeasured warmup and vsync-filtered FrameTiming.

visual.fixture: Synthetic ruled paper; no book content

interpretation: Fixes abrupt shadow appearance/disappearance near flat endpoints while preserving middle curl appearance. No stable speed improvement established; measured build and raster stages stay within the 60 Hz budget.
limitations: One 60 Hz iPhone; no 120 Hz or new Android hardware run in this iteration.
FrameTiming budget exceedance is not dropped-frame rate or touch-to-display latency.
Whole-process comparison RSS includes both reference and candidate workspaces; not a production memory measurement.
Synthetic pixel checks run in host Flutter tests; device functional checks use Flutter-injected gestures, not native OS interruption.
No Apple Books visual parity acceptance.
Books, real-book screenshots, private paths and signing/device identifiers are excluded.
